description: Source code for utility functions related to shader translation in ANGLE project, including float parsing, type handling, and shader variable analysis.

methods.name: atoi_clamp
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned int with clamping to max value on failure.

methods.name: NumericLexFloat32OutOfRangeToInfinity
methods.description: Parses a decimal string into float, converting out-of-range values to infinity or zero.

methods.name: strtof_clamp
methods.description: Parses a string into float with clamping, handling corner cases as per ESSL spec.

methods.name: GLVariableType
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL enum type for a given shader variable type.

methods.name: GLVariablePrecision
methods.description: Returns the precision qualifier for a shader variable type.

methods.name: ArrayString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of array sizes for a type.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of a type, possibly hashed if struct.

methods.name: IsVaryingOut
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is an output varying.

methods.name: IsVaryingIn
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is an input varying.

methods.name: IsVarying
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is either input or output varying.

methods.name: IsGeometryShaderInput
methods.description: Determines if a qualifier is valid for geometry shader input.

methods.name: GetInterpolationType
methods.description: Returns the interpolation type based on qualifier.

methods.name: GetShaderVariableBasicType
methods.description: Maps a shader variable to its basic type.

methods.name: DeclareGlobalVariable
methods.description: Declares a global variable in the shader AST.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL1
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 1.0.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL3OrGreater
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 3.0+.

methods.name: IsBuiltinOutputVariable
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is a built-in output variable.

methods.name: IsBuiltinFragmentInputVariable
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is a built-in fragment input variable.

methods.name: IsShaderOutput
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is a shader output.

methods.name: IsOutputESSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is ESSL.

methods.name: IsOutputGLSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is GLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputHLSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is HLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputVulkan
methods.description: Checks if shader output is Vulkan.

methods.name: IsOutputMetal
methods.description: Checks if shader output is Metal.

methods.name: IsInShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Determines if a node is in a shader storage block.

methods.name: GetImageInternalFormatType
methods.description: Returns GL enum for internal image format.

methods.name: IsSpecWithFunctionBodyNewScope
methods.description: Checks if shader spec and version require new scope for function body.

methods.name: GetConversion
methods.description: Determines implicit type conversion between two basic types.

methods.name: IsValidImplicitConversion
methods.description: Checks if a conversion is valid for a given operator.
